text: With SuppressSourceGeneration = true, should the analyzer still report the MsgPack0xx rules (MsgPack003/004/005 etc.) for the type?
options: Yes, all validation diagnostics still apply; only generation-specific ones (MsgPack011/016/017) are skipped
No, suppressed types are skipped entirely by the analyzer
why_it_matters: If yes, the early return and the tests asserting no diagnostics are wrong and the requirement is unmet. If no, the change meets the intent but the requirement text and the 3.1.0 parity criterion need revisiting.
